panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Accepted requests and sent mails per second. Sent below accepted means the worker is falling behind.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  countIf(kind = 'accepted') / $__interval_s AS accepted,
  countIf(kind = 'processed') / $__interval_s AS sent
FROM (SELECT timestamp, 'accepted' AS kind FROM message_accepted UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, 'processed' AS kind FROM message_processed)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Latency, accepted to sent
panels.description: Time from the API accepting a message to the worker handing it to SMTP, by when it was sent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(p.timestamp) AS time,
  quantile(0.5)(dateDiff('millisecond', a.timestamp, p.timestamp)) AS p50,
  quantile(0.95)(dateDiff('millisecond', a.timestamp, p.timestamp)) AS p95,
  max(dateDiff('millisecond', a.timestamp, p.timestamp)) AS max
FROM message_processed AS p
INNER JOIN message_accepted AS a ON a.messageId = p.messageId
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.timestamp)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Backlog
panels.description: Accepted minus sent, counted over all history. Dropped messages (invalid, SMTP 5xx) never get a sent row, so they stay in this count.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, backlog
FROM (
  SELECT time, sum(delta) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS backlog
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, sum(if(kind = 'accepted', 1, -1)) AS delta
    FROM (SELECT timestamp, 'accepted' AS kind FROM message_accepted UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, 'processed' AS kind FROM message_processed)
    GROUP BY time
  )
)
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sent per account
panels.description: Mails sent per second, one line per accountId.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  toString(accountId) AS account,
  count() / $__interval_s AS sent
FROM message_processed
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, account
ORDER BY time
